mediaWork.title: Give Up Tomorrow
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: The controversial conviction of Paco Larrañaga in the Philippines for the kidnapping, rape, and murder of the Chiong sisters; judicial corruption; flaws in the justice system; the death penalty.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: A young man from a prominent political family in the Philippines is accused of a double murder, despite evidence he was hundreds of miles away. This film traces a Kafkaesque miscarriage of justice.

mediaItems.focusOrTheme: The controversial conviction of Paco Larrañaga in the Philippines for the kidnapping, rape, and murder of the Chiong sisters; judicial corruption; flaws in the justice system; the death penalty.
mediaItems.summaryNotes: This documentary focuses on the conviction of Paco Larrañaga in the Philippines, highlighting issues of judicial corruption, flawed justice systems, and the death penalty. It examines the alibi evidence presented and the controversial testimony of a key witness.

featuredIndividuals.narrativeSummary: Francisco Juan "Paco" Larrañaga was convicted in the Philippines for the kidnapping, rape, and murder of the Chiong sisters. He maintains his innocence and presented alibi evidence. He is currently serving his sentence in Spain.
